name: Judicator
description: The judicator is an extra-planar zealot warrior that is tasked with hunting down dark and undead creatures, and those who utilize dark magic. They are relentless in doling out their version of justice against those who have been deemed sinners in the eyes of their master.

actions.name: Hammer Strike
actions.description: The judicator swing it's hammer at a creature, dealing physical damage.

actions.name: Heavenquake
actions.description: The judicator slams the ground with their hammer dealing divine damage to all creatures within a 3 unit radius of them. Creatures who botch their check also are launched 1d12 units into the air. This ability can only be used once per engagement.

actions.name: Pommel Strike
actions.description: The judicator makes a quick attack with the other end of their hammer, dealing physical damage. The target must make a resilience check against the total damage dealt after mitigation or become stunned.

actions.name: Judgement
actions.description: The judicator targets a humanoid within 8 units and attempts to judge them, making a contested insight check against the target's resistance. On a success, the judicator marks that target, causing the next Hammer Strike against them within the next minute to deal an additional 2d12 divine damage. The judgement automatically succeeds if the target has channeled a spell from the necromancy, witchcraft, or fiend school of magic within the last minute.

actions.name: Attack of Opportunity
actions.description: In response to a creature leaving their area of control, the judicator makes an attack with their Hammer Strike action.

actions.name: Angelic Wings
actions.description: The judicator sprouts angelic wings, gaining a flight speed of 10 until the start of it's next turn.

traits.name: Enemy of Darkness
traits.description: The judicator gains a 1d4 bonus against all attack and defense checks against undead and dark creatures.

traits.name: Divine Aura
traits.description: When a creature deals physical damage to the judicator with a melee attack, they take 1d8 radiant damage.
